subject: Abbreviated combined relation conditions
notes: kb/Work PB1390 landed (wave 68 s). Rule 1): the omission of the subject (cite.py --check 8.8.4.12.1 "The omission of the subject of the relation condition, or" OK). An abbreviated relation (comparisonOperator comparisonOperand) is now admitted as the leftmost element of EVERY connective's operand — after OR, XOR/EXCLUSIVE-OR and AND alike (it was OR-only-then-AND-only, AND-only, never after XOR) — and never first (the leading tiers begin with unaryLogicalExpression). BindAbbreviatedRelation inserts the carried subject; with none (after a class/sign/88/boolean condition, GR1's termination) it is now COBOL2552 (was the COBOL2319 internal-error net). Goldens: E2/E4/E6/E7 (85) and X1/X2/X3/X6/X7 (2023) over 81 tuples, 0 disagreements with the expansion.
